displayName: CyTube Fullscreen Video with Overlay Chat

modules.name: Movie Title Links
features: Full-screen Now Playing info card auto-triggered on title change — backdrop, poster, title/year, rating, runtime, genres, synopsis
IMDb / Letterboxd / Wikipedia badge links
Color-coded parental-guide content-warning chips
Floating stats strip + I hotkey to reopen the card

modules.name: IMDb Trivia
features: "Trivia" button appears once a movie is identified
Opens a floating panel of real IMDb trivia facts (T hotkey too)
Cached per-title

modules.name: Weekend Grindhouse Schedule
features: Full-screen "Coming Attractions" overlay with Friday/Saturday/Sunday tabs
Each night's themed blocks get distinct color/font, with poster art for every film
Glowing NOW PLAYING badge + dims already-shown films; click a poster to open its Now Playing card
Optional experimental ETA timing toggle

modules.name: TMDB Supplemental Images
features: Optional free API key upgrades poster/backdrop art quality (IMDb art is the fallback either way)
Adds a kill-count chip from a community horror database
Live key-validation Test button

modules.name: Grammar Check
features: Checks chat messages for grammar/spelling/mixed-up words via LanguageTool before sending (3s timeout, never blocks send)
Flags ALL-CAPS, keyyysmash, excessive punctuation
Inline review popup with click-to-fix suggestions
Skips @mentions, #hashtags, and URLs

modules.name: Emote Picker
features: Redesigned draggable emote panel — position remembered
Live search/filter, star-to-favorite with a pinned favorites row
Larger tiles with per-tile loading spinners, click-to-insert
Adapts to vertical/horizontal layout

modules.name: Embedded Chat Images
features: Auto-embeds inline image previews under chat messages linking directly to images
Per-image toggle between thumbnail/link view
Per-user "hide"/"unban" mute for specific image URLs
Keeps chat scrolled to bottom as embeds load

modules.name: Movie Sync Adjustment
features: Keeps local playback a few seconds ahead of the group's synced position during movies (not YouTube)
So your own buffering doesn't drop you out of sync
Adjustable 0-10s lead time via settings-modal field, 0 = off

modules.name: Subtitle Support
features: Load a local .srt/.vtt file, synced via native browser captions
Fine-tune offset with quick buttons/keyboard shortcuts
Adjustable caption size + drag-to-position on screen (both persisted)
One-click OpenSubtitles search; auto-restores your subtitles for ~6h per movie

modules.name: Up Next
features: Shows the channel's schedule/queue dashboard from a header button
Automatically hides itself if that dashboard isn't reachable

modules.name: GIF Maker
features: Capture any scene from the playing video as an animated GIF via a floating button
Scrubbable filmstrip with start/end handles
Meme-style top/bottom captions (color/shadow/wiggle) + effects (reverse, boomerang, speed, deep-fry, VHS, zoom-shake)
Adjustable FPS/width/aspect; download or one-click upload to ImgBB for a shareable link
